title: Father & Brownie Girl Scout at Home, 1950s California B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A heartwarming mid-century black and white snapshot capturing a proud father standing behind his young daughter, named Marlene, who is proudly wearing her Brownie Scout uniform complete with a beanie, belt pouch, and official pin. They are posed on a lush, manicured lawn directly in front of their suburban Spanish Revival home, featuring stucco walls, a red tile roof line, and an arched entry typical of post-WWII California architecture.
